field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable CARP L2 health monitoring. When enabled, CARP remains demoted until the configured checks satisfy the recovery threshold.

field.label: Probe interval
field.help: Seconds between ARP probes. Allowed range: 1-60 seconds.

field.label: Failure threshold
field.help: Consecutive failed probes required before this node globally demotes its CARP VHIDs.

field.label: Recovery threshold
field.help: Consecutive successful probes required before the CARP demotion is removed.
